about.text: A Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with over 6+ years of experience in C#, WPF, and .NET Framework, specializing in developing robust healthcare and diagnostic solutions. Proven expertise in Agile methodologies, medical device integration, and hospital Laboratory Information Systems (LIS). Combines strong full-stack and DevOps foundations with a track record of delivering scalable, patient-centric solutions, including integrating Generative AI (OpenAI) to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

experience.details: Medicover Project (Immunowell JCV Portal): Developed and scaled a comprehensive diagnostic platform connecting HCPs, logistics partners, and hospital Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) for sample collection and test result delivery. Actively participated in Agile methodologies and all sprint ceremonies. Implemented robust data extraction pipelines, querying complex XML lab reports and converting them into modern PDF formats. Delivered high-security foundations using C#, WPF, and .NET, including custom authentication and document management to handle sensitive medical data reliably.

PLM(Product Life Cycle Management of CAD Parts): Served as a Full Stack Senior Software Developer for an industry-standard PLM software, focusing on scalable version control architecture. Utilized Blazor, .NET Core API, and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), ensuring enterprise-grade stability and performance.

Code Whiz: Led the end-to-end development of an innovative Generative AI-driven coding assistant, leveraging the OpenAI API and Python/Flask to significantly boost developer productivity. My role included designing AI workflows, integrating LLMs, and guiding the team through complex feature implementations.

Credit Suite: Drove the modernization of a client's banking application (Credit Suite), adopting Blazor/Angular for the front end and DotNet Core/Azure Functions for serverless computing. Key responsibilities included managing the end-to-end deployment pipeline (Dev to UAT) and serving as the release engineer for a critical, user-centric banking solution.

IVY Retailer: Contributed to the success of IVY Retailer as a key member of the interface team, specializing in developing Restful services using DotNet Core and Angular for the front end. Executed responsibilities included writing unit test cases, managing complex stored procedures, and optimizing both procedures and code for defined user stories, ensuring a seamless product experience.
